title: Contrast Cycle
schedule: Fri - Day 4 - Lower Squat + Single Leg
Sat - Day 5 - Upper Body+ / Arms + Intervals
intro: Contrast Cycle: an 8-week program in the style of Marcus Filly's Functional Body Composition method, built from his free demo videos (Awaken Training Series, Upper Pushing, Single Leg Foundations, Kettlebell, Core, Rotational and Bodyweight playlists). Independent project, not affiliated with him.
Split: Mon Upper Horizontal, Tue Lower Hinge, Wed optional Pump Flow, Thu Upper Vertical, Fri Lower Squat + Single Leg, Sat Upper Body+ / Arms + Intervals, Sun rest.
What changes: two 4-week blocks. Block 1 (weeks 1-4) uses Templates A and B; Block 2 (weeks 5-8) uses all-new Templates C and D. You do 20 different strength sessions, each twice.
Progression: weeks 1-2: 3 sets, 75sec rest. Weeks 3-4: 4 sets, 60sec. Weeks 5-6: 3 sets, 75sec with Superset 1 at 4-6 reps (heavier). Weeks 7-8: 4 sets, 45sec with Superset 1 at 3-5 reps.
Each day: Superset 1 is low time under tension (heavy). Superset/Giant Set 2 is high time under tension (lighter, pump). Then a conditioning piece and a short finisher.
Tempo: 4 digits. 1st = lowering (seconds), 2nd = pause at the bottom, 3rd = lifting (X = explode), 4th = pause at the top. Example 31X1.
Week 9: deload. Half the sets, lighter loads, skip the conditioning. Then start another cycle.
